title: Gas-Liquid Two-Phase Flow Pattern Identification of a Centrifugal Pump Based on SMOTE and Artificial Neural Network.
summary: SMOTE plus ANN classifies gas-liquid two-phase flow patterns in a centrifugal pump; reported identification rate rises from 89.91% to 94.88% on the study test setup. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
